detailed_descriptions.en: Can’t get enough House Party? We feel you. That’s why we put together the HOUSE PARTY - Supporter Pack . This isn’t just any DLC — it’s a labor of back-alley love. Every HP dev threw their flair into this one, packing it with new story content, spicy cutscenes, fresh background chatter , and all sorts of outfits . Hell, it even comes with an art book , which is beyond rad! And here’s the real kicker: this DLC serves as a prelude. The new storylines set the stage for the world of OFFICE PARTY . Welcome to the next chapter, baby. New Story Content Delve further into Ashley's deep-rooted sibling rivalry issues with Madison, and help the girls put aside their differences and work together through a plumbing disaster. Ashley will be more than grateful for your help. Trust us. Help Derek prepare for his new job. He's trying to impress the new boss (Patrick!?) and can use your help to demonstrate that he's got what it takes. Like Ashley, Derek will be very grateful for your help! New Cutscenes Enjoy two brand-spanking new steamy cutscenes featuring Derek and Ashley, but also usable with any characters through the game's console. New Background Chatter Do you know all of the background chatter lines by heart? We've included some previously cut lines, and some fresh background chatter lines in this DLC for all original characters. So be on the look out for some fresh background chatters as well in this DLC! House Party Soundtrack Now you can listen to any of the House Party original songs outside of the game whenever you like! House Party - A Retbrahspective The Supporter Pack also includes an artbook about the history and evolution of House Party. This ebook has a brief history of the creation of House Party, and screenshots and images from older versions of the game, and up to the present. New Customization Options The House Party - Supporter Pack also includes new clothing and hairstyle customization options for the House Party characters. All Characters: 2 new hairstyles 2 new sets of glasses Female characters: 3 new top options 2 redesigned and retextured OG top options (Now compatible with all customizable female characters!) 3 new bottom options 2 redesigned and retextured OG bottom options (Now compatible with all customizable female characters!) 3 new undershirt options 3 new underwear options 2 redesigned and retextured OG underwear options (Now compatible with all customizable female characters!) 3 new shoe options 2 redesigned and retextured OG shoe options (Now compatible with all customizable female characters!) 1 new gloves option (possibly a couple more glove options) 1 new knee socks option 1 redesigned and retextured OG heart collar option (Now compatible with all customizable female characters!) 1 redesigned and retextured OG stud bracelet option (Now compatible with all customizable female characters!) Male characters: 3 new top options 2 redesigned and retextured OG top options (Now compatible with all customizable male characters!) 1 new bottom option 2 redesigned and retextured OG bottom options (Now compatible with all customizable male characters!) 1 new underwear option 2 redesigned and retextured OG underwear options (Now compatible with all customizable male characters!) 1 new shoe option 2 redesigned and retextured OG shoe options (Now compatible with all customizable male characters!) 1 redesigned and retextured OG watch option (Now compatible with all customizable male characters!) All of these items can be customized like other House Party clothing items. Mix and match these new items and existing items to create incredible character designs! The transformation options are endless! Select each item's primary and secondary colors and metallic properties. Then choose from over 100 patterns and customize the pattern's color, size, rotation, embossing, glow, and metallic properties. Add a decal to make it even more your own and then share it with the House Party community with our design sharing feature!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Can’t get enough House Party? We feel you. That’s why we put together the HOUSE PARTY - Supporter Pack.

This isn’t just any DLC — it’s a labor of back-alley love. Every HP dev threw their flair into this one, packing it with new story content, spicy cutscenes, fresh background chatter, and all sorts of outfits. Hell, it even comes with an art book, which is beyond rad!

And here’s the real kicker: this DLC serves as a prelude. The new storylines set the stage for the world of OFFICE PARTY. Welcome to the next chapter, baby.

New Story Content

Delve further into Ashley's deep-rooted sibling rivalry issues with Madison, and help the girls put aside their differences and work together through a plumbing disaster.  Ashley will be more than grateful for your help.  Trust us.

Help Derek prepare for his new job.  He's trying to impress the new boss (Patrick!?) and can use your help to demonstrate that he's got what it takes.  Like Ashley, Derek will be very grateful for your help!

New Cutscenes

Enjoy two brand-spanking new steamy cutscenes featuring Derek and Ashley, but also usable with any characters through the game's console.

New Background Chatter

Do you know all of the background chatter lines by heart?  We've included some previously cut lines, and some fresh background chatter lines in this DLC for all original characters. So be on the look out for some fresh background chatters as well in this DLC!

House Party Soundtrack

Now you can listen to any of the House Party original songs outside of the game whenever you like!

House Party - A Retbrahspective

The Supporter Pack also includes an artbook about the history and evolution of House Party.  This ebook has a brief history of the creation of House Party, and screenshots and images from older versions of the game, and up to the present.

New Customization Options

The House Party - Supporter Pack also includes new clothing and hairstyle customization options for the House Party characters.

All Characters:

  • 2 new hairstyles

  • 2 new sets of glasses

Female characters:

  • 3 new top options

  • 2 redesigned and retextured OG top options
    (Now compatible with all customizable female characters!)

  • 3 new bottom options

  • 3 new undershirt options

  • 3 new shoe options

  • 1 new gloves option (possibly a couple more glove options)

  • 1 new knee socks option

  • 1 redesigned and retextured OG heart collar option
    (Now compatible with all customizable female characters!)

  • 1 redesigned and retextured OG stud bracelet option
    (Now compatible with all customizable female characters!)

Male characters:

  • 3 new top options

  • 2 redesigned and retextured OG top options
    (Now compatible with all customizable male characters!)

  • 1 new bottom option

  • 2 redesigned and retextured OG bottom options
    (Now compatible with all customizable male characters!)

  • 1 new underwear option

  • 2 redesigned and retextured OG underwear options
    (Now compatible with all customizable male characters!)

  • 1 new shoe option

  • 2 redesigned and retextured OG shoe options
    (Now compatible with all customizable male characters!)

  • 1 redesigned and retextured OG watch option
    (Now compatible with all customizable male characters!)

All of these items can be customized like other House Party clothing items. Mix and match these new items and existing items to create incredible character designs! The transformation options are endless!

Select each item's primary and secondary colors and metallic properties. Then choose from over 100 patterns and customize the pattern's color, size, rotation, embossing, glow, and metallic properties. Add a decal to make it even more your own and then share it with the House Party community with our design sharing feature!
